entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-06-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • API Certificate Authentication Does Not Respect context.Fail("Failure reason"), always returns success. #62318
  • Perf regression: fortunes_ef #62317
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #62316
  • ValidatatableTypeAttribute does not work on records #62315
  • [Blazor] Serialization optimizations #62312
    Backlog
  • Missing required fields generates a 500 server error when using ExceptionHandler middleware #62311
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware, tls-renegotiation-httpsys #62309
  • [Known Build Error] `QuicConnectionContextTests.StreamPool_Heartbeat_ExpiredStreamRemoved` #62308

Closed

  • Perf regression: mvc #62310
  • Web app doesn't terminate when SIGTERM is sent to the process on Linux #62306

PullRequests

Created

  • [SignalR] [Java] Fix NPE when closing hub connection during negotiation #62319
    area-signalr, community-contribution
  • Fix: exit code is ignored. #62314
    area-infrastructure, 10.0-preview6

Merged

  • Merging internal commits for release/9.0 #62303
    9.0.7
  • Merging internal commits for release/8.0 #62302
    8.0.18

    8.0.18
